title: Legacy Archive Semantic Discovery
business: A historical research firm managing millions of digitized, unindexed archival documents.
problem: Researchers struggle to find relevant documents because traditional keyword searches fail to capture the conceptual intent or thematic connections between fragmented historical records.
solution: By utilizing text-embedding-ada-002, the firm converts unstructured text into high-dimensional vectors, enabling semantic search that retrieves documents based on conceptual similarity rather than exact keyword matching.
steps: Pre-process archival text into clean, tokenized segments.
Send text segments to the v1/embeddings endpoint using the text-embedding-ada-002 model.
Store the resulting numerical vector arrays in a specialized vector database.
Perform cosine similarity calculations between user query vectors and stored document vectors to rank search results.
outcome: Researchers can identify thematic patterns across disparate archives, significantly reducing the time required for deep historical investigation.
limitation: The model produces fixed-length vectors that represent the entire input; if a document is too long, the semantic focus may become diluted, which can be checked by evaluating the retrieval precision against known ground-truth document clusters.

import openai
# Requesting vector representation for a document snippet
response = openai.Embedding.create(
    input="Historical document text content",
    model="text-embedding-ada-002"
)
# The vector is found in response['data'][0]['embedding']
